title: Natural linear comparison for restriction of module sheaf stalks
statement: For every ringed space $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], open $W\subseteq X$ and $x\in W$, restriction of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] followed by the slice-site equivalence, the module stalk functor [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] at $x$ in $W$, and restriction of scalars along the inverse restriction-stalk ring isomorphism admits a natural $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-linear map to the original module stalk functor at $x$. For every module sheaf $F$ on $X$ and section $s$ on the image in $X$ of an open $V\subseteq W$ containing $x$, the restricted germ of $s$ maps to its original germ on that image. This statement involves only restriction, not extension by zero or an adjunction unit.

proof.text: Forget F to an abelian sheaf S. The slice-site equivalence identifies the underlying restricted presheaf with S restricted to W. The final neighborhood functor gives the additive restriction-stalk comparison, sending each restricted germ to the germ on the open image in X.

Represent a scalar and vector in the restricted stalk on two neighborhoods, then restrict both to their intersection. Apply the germ scalar multiplication law on W and on X and the ring restriction-stalk germ formula. The forward ring comparison cancels the inverse used for scalar transport, proving linearity over the original stalk ring.

For any module sheaf morphism, both naturality composites send the germ of a section to the germ of its image on X. Every stalk element is a germ, so the component maps are natural and form the required natural transformation.

proof_origin.place: Sheaves Section 6.31, Lemma 6.31.1 (3), Definition 6.31.2 (4); scalar and naturality details supplied by R1

theorem exists_moduleRestrictionStalk_morphism (X : RingedSpace.{u}) (W : Opens X)
    (x : X) (hx : x ∈ W) :
    ∃ c : SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X) W ⋙
        (W.sheafOfModulesEquivOver (moduleRings X)).functor ⋙
        RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor (X.restrict W.isOpenEmbedding) ⟨x, hx⟩ ⋙
        ModuleCat.restrictScalars
          (X.toPresheafedSpace.restrictStalkIso W.isOpenEmbedding ⟨x, hx⟩).inv.hom ⟶
      RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X x,
      ∀ (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) (V : Opens W)
        (hV : (⟨x, hx⟩ : W) ∈ V)
        (s : F.val.obj (op (W.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj V))),
        (c.app F) (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (C := Ab.{u})
          (X := (X.restrict W.isOpenEmbedding).carrier)
          ((W.sheafOfModulesEquivOver (moduleRings X)).functor.obj
            ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor (moduleRings X) W).obj F)).val.presheaf
          V ⟨x, hx⟩ hV s) =
        TopCat.Presheaf.germ (C := Ab.{u}) (X := X.carrier) F.val.presheaf
          (W.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj V) x ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hV, rfl⟩ s
